{{Quote|Jigunna is an industrial town, and Nem'ro runs most of the industry.|[[Minister of Intelligence (Galactic War)|Keeper]]|<ref name="TOR:CYNI">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|Claim Your New Identity|Hutta}}</ref>}}
'''Jiguuna''' was the name of a prominent industrial [[City/Legends|town]] built by [[Bakuush]] on the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]' adopted [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].

==History==
{{Quote|Nem'ro the Hutt's enemy took over part of this town. It's dangerous poking around in there.|[[Braden]]|<ref name="TOR:Gauntlet">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Gauntlet|Hutta}}</ref>}}
[[File:Jiguuna_Battle.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] fighting for Nem'ro are pinned down by Fa'athra's forces.]]
Around two centuries before the Cold War, the town's founder, Bakuush, died in a mechanical accident, resulting in a power vacuum in the town between several different gangs.<ref name="TOR:codex" /> Another Hutt, [[Suudaa Nem'ro]], came to control the town through blackmail and brutality, emerging from the vacuum as its undisputed ruler.<ref name="HoloNet">{{HolonetOld|biographies|nemro-hutt|Nem'ro the Hutt}}</ref>

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the town was the location of much violence between the [[Nem'ro's gang|forces]] of Nem'ro, and [[Fa'athra gang|those]] of a rival Hutt, [[Voontara Fa'athra]].<ref name="TOR:Gauntlet" /> Also during this era, all new arrivals to the planet were directed to the town's [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. Prominent visitors included the future [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]], who was sponsored by the Hutt for entry into [[Great Hunt (competition)|that competition]],<ref name="TOR:MS">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|My Sponsorship|Hutta}}</ref> and an [[Cipher Nine|agent]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], who convinced Nem'ro to support the Empire.<ref name="TOR:TNT">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|The New Truth|Hutta}}</ref>
